10276|d6f17c90.name: Rotgath Stonebeard
10276|d6f17c90.text: Aye, I would love ta teach ye a thing or two about smithing. Grab an apron and a hammer and let's see what we can accomplish shall we?

10277|de38fa19.name: Groum Stonebeard
10277|de38fa19.text: Ye know more than I do, that's a certainty. Tell ye what though, go talk with me da'. He'll want ye ta prove yerself, but he is a fine teacher indeed. His name's Rotgath, and ye'll find him near the anvils workin steel for ol' Bengus.

11028|ea44f66d.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|ea44f66d.text: I heard the new Henweigh 6000 will be rolling off the assembly line soon. I can barely contain my excitement!

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

1257|ed056522.name: Keldric Boucher
1257|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1265|a0959aba.name: Rudra Amberstill
1265|a0959aba.text: Welcome to the Amberstill Corral.  If you're interested in purchasing a mount, my husband Veron will be more than happy to help you choose just the right beast.  If you're looking for adventure, well we sure could use some help around here. . .

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

12997|6ce695f2.name: Monty
12997|6ce695f2.text: Monty be me name an' rats be me game.

1323|877c4b1d.name: Osric Strang
1323|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1340|76d04af9.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|76d04af9.text:
Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!

Thelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1430|b48f927f.name: Tomas
1430|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1632|fee38227.name: Adele Fielder
1632|fee38227.text: Since my husband left for the front, Helene here has been my strength. Her kind heart and sharp sword have helped me through a lot of tough times. I don't know what I would've done without her.

1681|d4740e3c.name: Brock Stoneseeker
1681|d4740e3c.text: The best miner has a firm grip on his pick, a stout heart in his chest, and thick, black dust in his hair.

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

2329|a28d29e1.name: Michelle Belle
2329|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

237|7ae4f953.name: Farmer Furlbrow
237|7ae4f953.text: Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

2455|105cd232.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2455|2237a3b1.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

2456|2237a3b1.name: Newton Burnside
2456|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

247226|58a0ba23.name: Kelsey Fargo
247226|58a0ba23.text: Blast these kobolds. I can't get any work done with them running back and forth, getting in my way. Well, I've got nothing better to do, would you like to learn about mining techniques? Or perhaps you just need some new tools?

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

248415|bdfaa98c.name: Tordrin Sternblade
248415|bdfaa98c.text: I heard ol' Marshal McBride was sendin' ye' my way.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

264936|6ba63b30.name: Earthseer Farsen
264936|6ba63b30.text: On a clear day, you can even see Blackrock Mountain from here. It's both beautiful and terrifying at the same time.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

4258|92cfadea.name: Bengus Deepforge
4258|92cfadea.text: I'm sorry lad but ye just don't have the foundation to learn what I have to teach. But don't fret, go speak with my student Rotgath, he'll help ye out.

491|02f3f1d4.name: Quartermaster Lewis
491|02f3f1d4.text: I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.

5113|b02b9fad.name: Kelv Sternhammer
5113|b02b9fad.text: The big wars might be over, for now, but we still have to keep our skills sharp!

514|9b2500eb.name: Smith Argus
514|9b2500eb.text: Of course I can help you with training. I'm just a journeyman myself, but I'm sure there's something I can show you.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

514|ca5296f2.name: Smith Argus
514|ca5296f2.text: I don't admit this lightly, but you are a far better smith than I am. If you want to learn more than my meager teachings then I suggest you seek out a Dwarf named Therum Deepforge in Stormwind. You will find him in the Dwarven District.

5164|105bb6dd.name: Grumnus Steelshaper
5164|105bb6dd.text: Ye bothered me for that? Ye'd be better off strapping a dead rabbit to yer back and running through a Troll's den than wearing that piece of garbage.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5509|211be282.name: Kathrum Axehand
5509|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5511|5ca9cced.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|5ca9cced.text: Ye have the look of a Blacksmith to ye. Soot under the nails, steel in yer bones. Aye, very much the blood of a Blacksmith in yer veins. Which means ye've come to me looking to learn a thing or two, well lad grab a hammer. Let's see what I can teach ye.

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5513|451d1c98.name: Gelman Stonehand
5513|451d1c98.text: I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.

5514|211be282.name: Brooke Stonebraid
5514|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

6031|86adad20.name: Tormus Deepforge
6031|86adad20.text: Some can't stand the heat of the Great Forge, but I think the heat is just right.  And it's the best place to do some serious smithwork.

6089|122548b3.name: Harry Burlguard
6089|122548b3.text:
It takes more than a big arm and a mean look to be a $c.  You also need a clear head and a sharp eye if you want to stay alive.

And bad breath doesn't hurt either.

6734|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Hearthstove
6734|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

7232|2ebb471e.name: Borgus Steelhand
7232|2ebb471e.text: What are ye daft? That's not a weapon, that's a dinner knife. I don't train amateurs.

823|b02f6a36.name: Deputy Willem
823|b02f6a36.text: Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...

911|7a171557.name: Llane Beshere
911|7a171557.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the $r race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

913|7a171557.name: Lyria Du Lac
913|7a171557.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the $r race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

927|837f02f9.name: Brother Wilhelm
927|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

957|8622dd6f.name: Dane Lindgren
957|8622dd6f.text: You're not bad, but let me show you a few tricks you might find handy.

957|a7a421b8.name: Dane Lindgren
957|a7a421b8.text: A far better blacksmith than I am, that's for sure. Though I'll deny it if you tell anyone I said that. You should go speak with Therum Deepforge. If anyone can teach you more, it's him.

963|f9eae059.name: Deputy Rainer
963|f9eae059.text:
I can't believe the officials in Stormwind, sending the bulk of our army abroad... when our home front is under so much pressure!

With thieves coming from Westfall and gnolls encroaching from from the east and west, it's a wonder Stormwind itself isn't besieged.

102-accept.name: Captain Danuvin
102-accept.text:
Stormwind has abandoned us.  A foul wind of depravity rustles through the plains of Westfall.  This was my homeland and I will not turn my back on the citizens who choose to remain here.  We, the former farmers, shall make our stand.

Your task, should you choose to accept, is to patrol the grasslands of Westfall.  Track down and slay the vile Gnolls that seem to be working in conjunction with the Deadmines thieves. Bring me eight Gnoll Paws and I will reward your bravery.
102-accept.title: Patrolling Westfall

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

107-progress.name: William Pestle
107-progress.text: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh?  I haven't seen Mildred in years!  I wonder what she has to say...
107-progress.title: Note to William

109-accept.name: Marshal Haggard
109-accept.text: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
109-accept.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

109-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
109-complete.text:
Ah, so my friend sent you here?  How kind.  

Well the Stormwind Monarchy has abandoned our cause.  Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption.  If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.
109-complete.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

1097-accept.name: Smith Argus
1097-accept.text:
There's a dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind, Grimand Elmore, who sent word that he needs help with a delivery.  I believe he wants a package sent to his homeland in the north.

You have a sturdy pair on you!  So if you're interested in some legwork then speak with Grimand.  We could use you down here, but we must also keep our ties strong with the dwarves.

You can find Grimand Elmore at the weapon shop in the Dwarven District of Stormwind, in the northeast section of town.
1097-accept.title: Elmore's Task

1097-complete.name: Grimand Elmore
1097-complete.text: You're here to help with my delivery?  Very good!
1097-complete.title: Elmore's Task

11-accept.name: Deputy Rainer
11-accept.text:
Gnolls, brutish creatures with no decent business in these lands, have been seen along the borders of Elwynn Forest.  A large pack of them, many more than we can handle alone, have infested the woods south of the guard tower yonder.  Another group has infested the areas near Stone Cairn Lake to the east.

The Stormwind Army will commend whomever helps kill them.  Bring me their painted gnoll armbands as proof of your deed.
11-accept.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

11-complete.name: Deputy Rainer
11-complete.text: I see you've been busy!  You have our thanks, $N.
11-complete.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

11-progress.name: Deputy Rainer
11-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Have you been killing Gnolls...?
11-progress.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

112-complete.name: William Pestle
112-complete.text: You got them.  Good show!  Now, just one moment while I concoct the potion...
112-complete.title: Collecting Kelp

112-progress.name: William Pestle
112-progress.text: Do you have that crystal kelp?  I'm sure Maybell is anxious to see her beau...
112-progress.title: Collecting Kelp

114-accept.name: William Pestle
114-accept.text: Take this invisibility liquor to young Maybell.  It should last long enough for her to visit Tommy Joe.
114-accept.title: The Escape

114-complete.name: Maybell Maclure
114-complete.text:
Oh...my!  I feel guilty deceiving my family, but my feelings for Tommy Joe are too strong to ignore.

Thank you, $N.  I'll drink this liquor as soon as I have the chance and sneak away to my love.

And for you... please take this.
114-complete.title: The Escape

114-progress.name: Maybell Maclure
114-progress.text: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe?  What did he say??
114-progress.title: The Escape

12-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-accept.text:
The People's Militia has but one goal:  To defend the lands of Westfall and return peace to our surroundings.  Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood. 

One of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby.  I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.
12-accept.title: The People's Militia

1338-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1338-accept.text:
There is a dwarven armorsmith whose work I admire greatly.  His name is Furen Longbeard, and his skill is unmatched.  I need a new shield, and I must have one of his!

The problem is... Furen is far to the south, in the dwarven district within Stormwind.  In $r lands!  I can't imagine why he would live there, so far from Ironforge.  The humans must pay him a king's ransom to keep him there!

So, if you want to travel and don't mind making some money, then will you send Furen my request for a shield?
1338-accept.title: Stormpike's Order

1338-complete.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-complete.text:
Ah, a request from one of the Stormpikes.  That's a proud clan, full of quality dwarves.  Rich ones, too.

Thank you, $N.  I'll get to work on Mountaineer Stormpike's shield by the end of the day.
1338-complete.title: Stormpike's Order

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

1339-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1339-accept.text:
I hear Mountaineer Stormpike is looking for a runner.  Someone to do a little traveling for him.  How about it?  Are you the $r for the job?

If so, then you'll find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower.
1339-accept.title: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task

1339-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1339-complete.text:
That's right.  I have a task that I can't do while I'm guarding.  In fact, it'll take you far from Loch Modan.

Your perfect chance for adventure!
1339-complete.title: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task

15-accept.name: Marshal McBride
15-accept.text:
$N, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought.  A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.

Go to the mine and remove them.  We know there are at least 10.  Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
15-accept.title: Investigate Echo Ridge

151-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-accept.text:
Poor Old Blanchy!  Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.

I bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.
151-accept.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-accept.name: Scout Galiaan
153-accept.text:
The Defias Front is constantly shifting.  I've been following their movements for quite some time now.  On a side note, I've ascertained that many members of the gang can be tracked by the Red Leather Bandanas they wear.

Bring me 15 of these Bandanas and I'll see to it you are rewarded.
153-accept.title: Red Leather Bandanas

1578-accept.name: Tormus Deepforge
1578-accept.text:
The mountaineers of Loch Modan are fighting troggs, and having a busy time of it!  They need constant supplies of new armor and weapons if we're ever to get a handle on those troggs.

That's why my colleague Thorvald is there, trying to keep the mountaineers in good gear.  So if you were to make some copper axes and copper chain belts and bring them to Thorvald, he would be obliged.  He might even share his knowledge with you.

Thorvald is in Loch Modan's southern guard tower.
1578-accept.title: Supplying the Front

16-progress.name: Gerard Tiller
16-progress.text:
Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.

If you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.
16-progress.title: Give Gerard a Drink

1618-accept.name: Tormus Deepforge
1618-accept.text:
We dwarves aren't the only ones fighting.  Our $r allies have their hands full too!

Redridge is under periodic attack from blackrock orcs, and their supply of equipment is always low.  If you were to help them out, I'm sure their resident blacksmith, Verner Osgood, would teach you a trick or two.
1618-accept.title: Gearing Redridge

1618-complete.name: Verner Osgood
1618-complete.text:
Thank you, $N.  This will help me out tremendously.  With the Blackrock orcs attacking from Stonewatch Keep and the Redridge gnolls lurking in the foothills to the north, I'm always fixing armor and making new weapons for our troops.

The supplies you brought will give me a moment's peace.  I will have enough time to teach you something...
1618-complete.title: Gearing Redridge

1618-progress.name: Verner Osgood
1618-progress.text: I hope you're here with good news from Ironforge.  Because I'm at my wit's end!
1618-progress.title: Gearing Redridge

1638-accept.name: Lyria Du Lac
1638-accept.text:
You've shown yourself to be a competent $c, $N.  But you're still young and have a lot to learn.

Speak with Harry Burlguard--he's usually in the Pig and Whistle tavern, in the Old Town of Stormwind.  Harry is an old veteran and a good teacher.  He can show you a few moves that'll keep you breathing longer.
1638-accept.title: A Warrior's Training

1638-complete.name: Harry Burlguard
1638-complete.text:
Oh ho!  Have a drink with me, lad.  You look tough on the outside, but let's see if your gut can handle a few mugs of the Pig and Whistle's strongest!!

Or... were you here for a lesson?
1638-complete.title: A Warrior's Training

1639-accept.name: Harry Burlguard
1639-accept.text:
Yeah, I can teach you.  But first I wanna see what moves you have already.

See that drunk over there at the end of the bar?  Bartleby?  I want you to get his mug.

Hah, and if you know Bartleby then you know he won't just give it to you.
1639-accept.title: Bartleby the Drunk

1639-complete.name: Bartleby
1639-complete.text: Hello, fancy boy!  What's a prissy thing like you doing in the Pig and Whistle?  Be careful, or you might break a nail...
1639-complete.title: Bartleby the Drunk

1640-accept.name: Bartleby
1640-accept.text:
You want what??  You're crazy!

The only way you'll get this mug is if you pry it from my cold, dead fingers...
1640-accept.title: Beat Bartleby

1640-complete.name: Bartleby
1640-complete.text: You're a lot tougher than you look!
1640-complete.title: Beat Bartleby

1665-accept.name: Bartleby
1665-accept.text: Ok, here's my mug.  Wait!  Let me finish what's in it first... there we go.
1665-accept.title: Bartleby's Mug

1665-complete.name: Harry Burlguard
1665-complete.text:
There it is!  He sure didn't want to part with it, but you were persuasive.  Well done.

Now for your lesson...
1665-complete.title: Bartleby's Mug

1665-progress.name: Harry Burlguard
1665-progress.text: I saw your fight with Bartleby.  Nicely done!  Did you get his mug?
1665-progress.title: Bartleby's Mug

1666-accept.name: Harry Burlguard
1666-accept.text:
You've learned a few moves, but you could still use a decent weapon.  I bet if you spoke with Marshal Haggard he could help you.

Marshal Haggard lives in a manor in Elwynn Forest, at the Eastvale Lumber Camp.  He's retired now but he collected a lot of gear during his career.

Let him know I sent you, and with luck he'll have a spare weapon to offer.
1666-accept.title: Marshal Haggard

1666-complete.name: Marshal Haggard
1666-complete.text: Who's that?  Burlguard, is that you?  You'll have to step a little closer.  My eyes aren't what they used to be.  Walking up like that, I thought you were a gnoll!
1666-complete.title: Marshal Haggard

1667-accept.name: Marshal Haggard
1667-accept.text:
Burlguard sent you, did he?  Yes, I have spare weapons around here, but first I have a task for you...

A while ago a Defias villain Dead-tooth Jack tricked me.  It was dark and he was wearing a Stormwind tabard and I thought he was Marshal Dughan.  He said he needed my old Stormwind Marshal's badge and I gave it to him... and then he laughed and ran off before I could catch him!

Get back my badge!  Dead-tooth Jack probably has it stowed in his camp to the south.
1667-accept.title: Dead-tooth Jack

1667-complete.name: Marshal Haggard
1667-complete.text:
Great, you found it!  I feared it was gone forever, used by the Defias to impersonate a Stormwind official.  Well that won't happen now, thanks to you.

Here are some weapons I used when I was a Marshal.  I kept them in great shape--take your pick!
1667-complete.title: Dead-tooth Jack

1667-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
1667-progress.text: Do you have my badge? I don't want to think of the mischief Dead-tooth Jack could cause with it.
1667-progress.title: Dead-tooth Jack

1680-accept.name: Muren Stormpike
1680-accept.text:
Now that you've learned some moves, it's time to get you a decent weapon.  Speak with Tormus Deepforge.  He can make you a weapon I'm sure you'll like.

You'll find Tormus here in Ironforge, at the Great Forge.
1680-accept.title: Tormus Deepforge

1680-complete.name: Tormus Deepforge
1680-complete.text:
Muren sent you, did he?  Yes, I can make you a nice weapon... but before I do that, I have a favor to ask of you.

Don't worry.  It's plenty dangerous and could mean your death; it's exactly the sort of job a $c wants.
1680-complete.title: Tormus Deepforge

1681-accept.name: Tormus Deepforge
1681-accept.text:
My mentor, Sturgy Ironband, had a compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh.  There he taught blacksmithing and he was the best.

But one day, one of his students brought him a load of strange ore.  Master Ironband called it umbral ore and was eager to work with it, but soon after it arrived... a band of Dark Iron dwarves attacked his compound.  They killed everyone!

Enter Ironband's compound, $N, and avenge my master's death.  And bring me the load of umbral ore that caused it.
1681-accept.title: Ironband's Compound

1681-complete.name: Tormus Deepforge
1681-complete.text:
You found it! Well done!

I hope you killed a host of Dark Iron dwarves while searching.  I fear that Ironband's compound won't be the last place we see them.

But thank you for the ore, $N.  I'm eager to work it and find its properties.
1681-complete.title: Ironband's Compound

1681-progress.name: Tormus Deepforge
1681-progress.text: Have you entered Ironband's Compound?  Did you find the umbral ore?
1681-progress.title: Ironband's Compound

1682-complete.name: Tormus Deepforge
1682-complete.text:
Here are some weapons, hot off the anvil and made with the new umbral ore you brought me!

Please, $N, take your pick!
1682-complete.title: Grey Iron Weapons

176-accept.name: Unknown
176-accept.text:
Wanted: Hogger

A huge gnoll, Hogger, is prowling the woods in southwestern Elwynn.  He has overpowered all attempts at his capture.

The Stormwind Army has placed a generous bounty on the Gnoll.  To earn the reward, bounty hunters should bring proof of Hogger's demise to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
176-accept.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

176-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
176-complete.text:
Hah!  Well done!  I was starting to think no one would take down that monster!

Here you are, $N.  And thanks - that Gnoll was giving me a headache the size of Blackrock Spire!
176-complete.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

18-accept.name: Deputy Willem
18-accept.text:
Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire.  They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.

I don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good!  Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
18-accept.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

18-complete.name: Deputy Willem
18-complete.text: Back with some bandanas, I see.  The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.
18-complete.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

184-accept.name: Unknown
184-accept.text:
This is the deed to an expanse of farmlands within Westfall.  It is signed by a Theodore Furlbrow and cosigned by his wife, Verna.  And on the back of the deed are hastily scrawled words:

"We leaned on Furlbrow and got his deed.  Thought it might be handy if you wanted to forge one of these for your own place.

The Furlbrows won't give us trouble.  Last I saw them they were on their way out of Westfall, stuck with a broken wagon."

You think the Furlbrows might want their deed back...
184-accept.title: Furlbrow's Deed

184-complete.name: Farmer Furlbrow
184-complete.text:
Loads of thanks, $N!  As I was saying, these parts aren't fit for honest folk anymore, but if things get better, then this deed will let us reclaim our land.

I don't have much to offer you, but here -- take this.
184-complete.title: Furlbrow's Deed

184-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
184-progress.text:
You have the deed to my farm??  That's good news!  Some ruffians stole it days ago... I thought it was gone for good!

Please, let me have it.  We're on our way out of Westfall and ain't coming back any time soon, but if we do then we'll need those papers...
184-progress.title: Furlbrow's Deed

21-complete.name: Marshal McBride
21-complete.text: Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the Stormwind Army.  There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them.  We have further tasks for you.
21-complete.title: Skirmish at Echo Ridge

2158-accept.name: Falkhaan Isenstrider
2158-accept.text:
Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!

My best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.

To find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!
2158-accept.title: Rest and Relaxation

2158-complete.name: Innkeeper Farley
2158-complete.text:
Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold -- that's our motto! Please, take a seat by the fire and rest your weary bones.

Would you like to try a sampling of some of our fine food and drink?
2158-complete.title: Rest and Relaxation

22-accept.name: Salma Saldean
22-accept.text: The onions are peeled.  The garlic is minced.  The rosemary is crushed.  The crust has been baked.  The dill weed is chopped.  The gravy is simmering.  Now all I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-accept.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

224-accept.name: Mountaineer Cobbleflint
224-accept.text:
We need to protect the Loch, $N!  With so many of the King's soldiers fighting valiantly on remote battlefields, we've become overwhelmed on the home front.  Troggs are tunneling up from every crevice!  The Trogg infestation poses the largest threat to Ironforge.  These disgusting mutants must be destroyed.

We need you, brave adventurer, to venture forth and lay waste to the Trogg threat.  Slay 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts and report back.
224-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

224-complete.name: Mountaineer Cobbleflint
224-complete.text:
Well done, $N!  You demonstrated uncanny courage on the battlefield.  Our war against the Troggs will be won with efforts such as yours.  You have served King Magni well.

If you fancy yourself well-suited for this kind of adventuring, I suggest you speak with Mountaineer Gravelgaw.  The Captain has him assigned to a rough patrol that I am sure he can use some help with.  Check with Gravelgaw just inside the tower.
224-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

237-accept.name: Mountaineer Gravelgaw
237-accept.text:
Mountaineer Cobbleflint had nothing but good things to say about you, $r.  For that reason I am going to entrust upon you a mission of utmost importance.  We need to keep pressure on the invading Trogg forces until our Dwarven brethren return from the Alliance front.

Set forth into the southern hills and kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers.  Your attacks will buy us some time.  Report back when your mission is complete.
237-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

239-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
239-accept.text:
The Garrison on our western border sends word of increasing gnoll and thief activity.  They're requesting we send more Stormwind soldiers... but we just don't have any to spare!

If you can help, we could use it.  Go and speak with Deputy Rainer at the Westbrook Garrison and see what he needs done.

The Garrison is down the road to the west.  After you cross the bridge over the small brook it will be to the right.
239-accept.title: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!

239-complete.name: Deputy Rainer
239-complete.text:
Marshall Dughan sent you, eh?  Well you're not from the army, but if Dughan sent you then that's good enough for me!

Our situation is, to say the least, a stressed one.  I hope you can give us a hand.
239-complete.title: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!

267-accept.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-accept.text:
$C, you may or may not be aware of the Trogg threat looming over Dwarven lands.  With the Ironforge Reserve called up to the Alliance Front, we are left with a fraction of the defense forces needed to keep these lands safe.  My regiment is assigned to watch over the Gate here and we cannot leave our post for fear of invasion.

But we need some pressure put on those damned Troggs lurking in the hills.  If you're up to the task, wage an assault on the Troggs.  Bring me back 8 Trogg Stone Teeth as proof.
267-accept.title: The Trogg Threat

267-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-complete.text: I am quite impressed, $N.  You have done the Dwarven race a great favor by defending our lands.  King Magni Bronzebeard himself would be proud!
267-complete.title: The Trogg Threat

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

307-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-accept.text:
The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago.  It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now Kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, Dwarven tools!

We'll root out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things.  It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side.

The gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine.  Good luck.
307-accept.title: Filthy Paws

307-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-complete.text: Did you see a lot of Kobolds in there?  I can't wait for the order to clear them out of the mine.  The thought of their grimy hands clawing around our mine makes my stomach rumble!
307-complete.title: Filthy Paws

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

3100-accept.name: Marshal McBride
3100-accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Llane, our local $c trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
3100-accept.title: Simple Letter

3100-complete.name: Llane Beshere
3100-complete.text:
Get yourself squared away, learn the layout of the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.

The Knights of the Silver Hand have done well in making this place fairly safe, but as you meet the other citizens, I think you'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a $c can give them. Good luck.
3100-complete.title: Simple Letter

3100-progress.name: Llane Beshere
3100-progress.text:
Ah, you got my letter, $N... good.

There's been an influx of warriors in Elwynn recently--which is good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and Defias in the area.
3100-progress.title: Simple Letter

314-accept.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-accept.text:
We heard the cries in the middle of the night.  Then this morning, sure enough, the herd was missing two rams.  That dastardly beast known as Vagash has been preying on our livelihood.  With most of King Magni's army off in distant lands fighting with the Alliance, there is no one to keep Vagash at bay.

Perhaps you are brave enough to seek out the beast and slay him.  Bring me one of his fangs and I will reward you.  Vagash lurks just above the ranch here, but be warned, he is deadly.
314-accept.title: Protecting the Herd

314-complete.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-complete.text: Very well done!  Veron will be so happy when he hears the good news.  To kill Vagash is no easy task.  I imagine one day you'll be fighting alongside King Magni's men on the Alliance Front.
314-complete.title: Protecting the Herd

314-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-progress.text: Vagash still terrorizes the herd!  Please help us by killing the wretched beast.
314-progress.title: Protecting the Herd

33-complete.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-complete.text:
You've been busy!  I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...

I have some things here you might want - take your pick!
33-complete.title: Wolves Across the Border

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

353-accept.name: Grimand Elmore
353-accept.text:
The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes.  So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.

The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan.  If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?

My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.
353-accept.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-complete.text:
Aha!  So Grimand finally finished my axe!  I can't wait to try it against some troggs and kobolds!

Many thanks, $N.  It was a long distance to travel for this delivery.   Here are some coins for your efforts.
353-complete.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the $r lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

36-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
36-accept.text:
I never thought the day would come when I'd leave the farm.  But the fields are overrun with thieves and it's far too dangerous for us here now.  As soon as Farmer Furlbrow gets the wagon fixed, we'll be on our way.  
 
Maybe you could do me a favor?  Let me scribble down my recipe for Westfall stew.  Please take it to Salma Saldean over on the farm yonder.  The Saldean's farm is just beyond the fork in the road.
36-accept.title: Westfall Stew

36-complete.name: Salma Saldean
36-complete.text: That Verna was always such a sweet lass.  We'll miss her here in Westfall but between you and me, she's a city girl at heart and Stormwind will suit her just fine.  But enough gossip!  Now we can make Westfall Stew!
36-complete.title: Westfall Stew

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

37-complete.name: Guard Thomas
37-complete.text: Although much has been stripped from the corpse, strewn nearby is a medallion with the words: "Footman Malakai Stone" etched upon it.
37-complete.title: Find the Lost Guards

38-accept.name: Salma Saldean
38-accept.text:
Help me make some Westfall Stew!  Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-accept.title: Westfall Stew

39-accept.name: Guard Thomas
39-accept.text:
Tell Marshal Dughan of Malakai and Rolf's deaths, and report to him that the Murlocs in eastern Elwynn cannot be contained by our current troop presence.

I know we don't have many troops to spare, but hopefully Dughan can find someone.
39-accept.title: Deliver Thomas' Report

39-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
39-complete.text:
Hmm, this news is troubling.  Already our defenses are stretched thin, and losing Rolf and Malakai to those murlocs put us in an even worse position.

If things don't improve, there will be fighting in Goldshire by the week's end!
39-complete.title: Deliver Thomas' Report

3903-accept.name: Deputy Willem
3903-accept.text:
You've shown yourself a dependable $c, $N.  Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?

I have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble.  She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable.  I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.
3903-accept.title: Milly Osworth

3903-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3903-complete.text:
Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me?  He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at Northshire Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.

Perhaps you can help me?
3903-complete.title: Milly Osworth

3904-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3904-accept.text:
A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting!  I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes!  If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.

Please, you must help me!  I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.

Bring me those crates!  Save my harvest!
3904-accept.title: Milly's Harvest

3904-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3904-complete.text:
Oh thank you, $N!  You saved my harvest!  And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.

We might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!
3904-complete.title: Milly's Harvest

3905-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3905-accept.text:
Now that my crop is saved, take this Grape Manifest to Brother Neals.  He manages the store of food and drink in Northshire, and I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear that he has fresh grapes.

You'll find Brother Neals in the abbey, in the bell tower... where he likes to taste his wine.
3905-accept.title: Grape Manifest

3905-complete.name: Brother Neals
3905-complete.text:
Let's see here...

Oh my!  Milly's grapes have been saved!  When she told me that brigands overran her vineyards I nearly despaired, but my faith in the Light did not waver!

And through your bravery,  we now have grapes for more wine!  May the Light bless you, $N, and keep you safe!
3905-complete.title: Grape Manifest

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

416-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-accept.text:
We have a real infestation problem to the west.  Tunnel rat kobolds have moved into the foothills, setting up dens and fouling our land with their filth!

We want them eliminated.  Hunt them, bring me their ears and earn their bounty.

You can find tunnel rat kobolds and their dens west of Thelsamar, littered along the mountainside.
416-accept.title: Rat Catching

416-complete.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-complete.text:
Ugh!  When I asked for those ears I didn't realize they'd smell so bad!

Here's your reward, $N.  Well done.
416-complete.title: Rat Catching

416-progress.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-progress.text: Hail, $N.  How goes the rat catching?
416-progress.title: Rat Catching

418-accept.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-accept.text:
There's never a shortage of empty bellies here in Thelsamar, kids running in and out, workers from the excavation coming in after  a hard day's work. We're famous for our blood sausages, I don't suppose you've ever tried them?

No? Well, around here you've got to work for your meals, and don't think just because you're a fancy $c, you'll be any exception.

I'll need bear meat, boar intestines for the casings, and spider ichor for spice. You get me some of those, and leave the cooking to Vidra!
418-accept.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

418-complete.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-complete.text:
Trust me, it seems a lot harder than it looks, but...

Oh, I've never known someone to take much interest in the making of sausages, but I'll give you the recipe just in case. Here you go, mind you eat them fresh!
418-complete.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

436-accept.name: Jern Hornhelm
436-accept.text:
Prospector Ironband is heading an excavation of ancient ruins east of the lake.  His progress has been slow lately, especially considering all the supplies we've sent him.

Ironband's a stout, honest dwarf who values results, which has me worried that forces are at work against him.

Go to Ironband's Excavation and speak with Magmar Fellhew.  He manages the details of the site and will know why there's a slowdown.

To get to the excavation site, go around the southern tip of the lake, then head east.
436-accept.title: Ironband's Excavation

45-accept.name: Unknown
45-accept.text:
Upon further searching the area, you find webbed footprints leading east along the shore of Stone Cairn Lake.  In the distance to the east, you can just barely see a Murloc village.

Perhaps Rolf's fate ended there...
45-accept.title: Discover Rolf's Fate

45-complete.name: Unknown
45-complete.text: You find around the neck of the corpse a metal medallion inscribed with the words "Footman Rolf Hartford."
45-complete.title: Discover Rolf's Fate

46-accept.name: Guard Thomas
46-accept.text:
The Stormwind Army has placed a bounty on murloc lurkers and foragers in Elwynn.  Slaughter them and bring me their torn murloc fins, and the Stormwind Army will reward you well.

The murlocs have built a village at Stone Cairn Lake north of here, and another to the south where the stream forks.
46-accept.title: Bounty on Murlocs

46-complete.name: Guard Thomas
46-complete.text:
You have the fins?  Great!  Marshal Dughan is anxious about the Murloc situation in eastern Elwynn, and I'd like to tell him that it's becoming under control.

Your actions have helped realize that.
46-complete.title: Bounty on Murlocs

47-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-accept.text:
The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them.  I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!

You can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.
47-accept.title: Gold Dust Exchange

47-progress.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-progress.text: Psst!  You have that Gold Dust for me...for me?
47-progress.title: Gold Dust Exchange

52-complete.name: Guard Thomas
52-complete.text:
Thanks a lot for the help, $N.  Something in the forest must be making these animals so bold.

Whatever it is, I hope it stays there.
52-complete.title: Protect the Frontier

54-accept.name: Marshal McBride
54-accept.text:
$N, you are a $c with proven interest in the security of Northshire.  You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding Elwynn Forest.

If you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.  Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.
54-accept.title: Report to Goldshire

54-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
54-complete.text:
Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the Stormwind Marshals.  Congratulations.

And good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... what with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!

It's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...
54-complete.title: Report to Goldshire

54-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
54-progress.text:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54-progress.title: Report to Goldshire

5545-accept.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-accept.text:
I've got a real problem on my hands. I have a deadline looming for an order of lumber, and I'm running out of time. The wolves and bears north of here have chased my workers away from the bundles of wood that they've already chopped.

I've already talked to Deputy Rainer about clearing the animals, but I need someone to go collect the wood for me. If you could collect eight bundles of wood for me I might just make my deadline.
5545-accept.title: A Bundle of Trouble

5545-complete.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-complete.text:
Excellent! Thanks to you, I should be able to complete the order in time. To show my gratitude, I would like to offer some coin as compensation for your troubles.

Thank you and farewell.
5545-complete.title: A Bundle of Trouble

5545-progress.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
5545-progress.title: A Bundle of Trouble

59-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
59-accept.text:
For your shrewdness and valor, I have a marker here that is good for one piece of armor.  I want you to take it to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp.  Give her the marker, and she will fashion the armor for you.  And after you receive it, $N, use it in the defense of Elwynn.

The Eastvale Logging Camp is beyond Guard Thomas' post to the east.
59-accept.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

59-complete.name: Sara Timberlain
59-complete.text:
Ah, thank you for the marker.  Please feel free to pick your choice of armor.

Luck to you, brave $c.  And may this armor serve you well.
59-complete.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

59-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
59-progress.text:
I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.

If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
59-progress.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

6-accept.name: Deputy Willem
6-accept.text:
Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge.  Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!

But be wary, $N.  Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him.  He will not be an easy man to reach.
6-accept.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6-complete.name: Deputy Willem
6-complete.text: Hah - you caught him!  You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!
6-complete.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

60-accept.name: William Pestle
60-accept.text:
Hello, good sir!  Do you have a moment?

My brother and I run an apothecary in Stormwind, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax.  Can you help me?

You can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines ... the Fargodeep mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east.  I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.
60-accept.title: Kobold Candles

60-progress.name: William Pestle
60-progress.text: Did you gather those candles yet?
60-progress.title: Kobold Candles

61-complete.name: Morgan Pestle
61-complete.text: Here is your payment ... and while you're here, take a look around!  I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.
61-complete.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

6181-accept.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6181-accept.text:
Although we don't get much aid from Stormwind directly, I do have a contact in the city who helps supply us with armor.  His name is Osric Strang.  His shop, Limited Immunity, is in the Old Town of Stormwind.

Our supply of armor dwindles, and I must contact Osric for more.  Can you take him this note?

The fastest way to Stormwind is through Thor, our gryphon master.  He's just down the hill; bring him my note, and then take a gryphon to Stormwind.
6181-accept.title: A Swift Message

6181-complete.name: Thor
6181-complete.text: You have to get this note to Stormwind?  That's not a problem, you can take one of my gryphons!
6181-complete.title: A Swift Message

6181-progress.name: Thor
6181-progress.text: You look like you're in a hurry.  Well, then you came to the right place!
6181-progress.title: A Swift Message

62-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
62-accept.text:
The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.

Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
62-accept.title: The Fargodeep Mine

6261-accept.name: Osric Strang
6261-accept.text:
$N, I gathered into this crate everything Lewis asked for.  Can you take it to him?

If you've already spoken to Thor in Westfall, then you can take a gryphon back to him.  Dungar Longdrink is our gryphon master, over in the trade district.

Speak with Dungar, then get this crate to Lewis as fast as you can.  We don't want our fighting men and women in Westfall to go without fresh equipment!
6261-accept.title: Dungar Longdrink

6261-complete.name: Dungar Longdrink
6261-complete.text: A crate for Westfall, eh?  Have you been to Westfall before?  If so, then it's no problem, my friend.  I have plenty of gryphons trained to fly that route!
6261-complete.title: Dungar Longdrink

6261-progress.name: Dungar Longdrink
6261-progress.text: Is that sweat on your brow, lad?  You've been running too much.  Next time, take a gryphon!
6261-progress.title: Dungar Longdrink

6281-accept.name: Thor
6281-accept.text:
For a small fee, you can take a gryphon to Stormwind, so you can deliver Lewis' note to Osric.  You won't get there faster any other way.

If that sounds acceptable, then just speak to me again when you're ready for the ride.  I'll charge you a little, but trust me; it'll be worth it!
6281-accept.title: Continue to Stormwind

6281-complete.name: Osric Strang
6281-complete.text:
Ah, a note from Quartermaster Lewis?  I'm not surprised he needs more gear.  Sentinel Hill is far away, in a land Stormwind has all but forgotten.

Well thank you, $N.  Here's some money to cover your travel costs.
6281-complete.title: Continue to Stormwind

6281-progress.name: Osric Strang
6281-progress.text: You've been traveling, eh?  Have you been anywhere interesting?
6281-progress.title: Continue to Stormwind

6285-accept.name: Dungar Longdrink
6285-accept.text:
The gryphon master in Westfall is Thor.  If you've spoken to him before, then you can take one of my gryphons to him.

That's a good lesson to know: gryphons are always trained to fly to their capital city, but they'll only take you to a remote gryphon master after you've already been there.

You've already been to Thor, so just speak with me again when you're ready to take a gryphon to Westfall.  Once there, you can deliver Osric's Crate to Quartermaster Lewis.
6285-accept.title: Return to Lewis

6285-complete.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6285-complete.text:
Great, you brought the armor!  We'll get this divvied to those who need it immediately.

Thank you, $N.  Your efforts have been a great help to us.  And now that you're no stranger to gryphons, I hope you'll come and lend your aid to Sentinel Hill often!
6285-complete.title: Return to Lewis

6285-progress.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6285-progress.text: You're back from Stormwind?  Did Osric send the armor?
6285-progress.title: Return to Lewis

64-accept.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-accept.text: It was horrible!  Verna woke me when she heard a ruckus in the fields.  The fields were full of hooligans.  We left in a rush and I forgot to pack my pocket watch.  Verna's pa gave me that watch on our wedding day and I feel just sick knowing those thieves have it.  I left the pocket watch in the wardrobe at the farmhouse.  Look for the field of pumpkins to the West -- you can't miss it.  If you bring it back to me, I'd sure be grateful!
64-accept.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

65-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
65-accept.text:
The band of wretches responsible for driving the good people of Westfall from the land call themselves The Defias Brotherhood.  I need you to infiltrate this clan of thugs.  We need to know who heads up the cartel and where they are hiding out.  In Lakeshire, in the inn, there is a rogue by the name of Wiley who owes me a favor.

Travel to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, east of Elwynn, and find out what you can.
65-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

6661-accept.name: Monty
6661-accept.text:
Avast ye scallywag. Arrrr... Arrrr ye looking fer work? We gots a serious rat problem down here an' not enough hands on the poop deck.

What do ye say? All ye needs to do is take this here rat catchin' flute and play the melody around the vermin. They'll follow ye to the ends of the world!

Just capture five of the little buggers and bring em back here. We needs em alive.

Arrrrr...
6661-accept.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6661-complete.name: Monty
6661-complete.text: These'll werk nicely, matey. Me brother needs em still tickin' and kickin,' else they go sour... Ye don't want to taste no sour rat kabob.
6661-complete.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6662-accept.name: Monty
6662-accept.text:
Me brother, Nipsy, runs a rat kabob operation on the other side of Deeprun. Ye needs to take this here crate o' rats to him before they go bad. Get a move on!

Ye have ridden a tram before, aye? It's easy. Just step aboard when she arrives and enjoy the ride. An' keep yer arms and legs inside durin' the ride, lest ye be peglegged fer life.
6662-accept.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

7-complete.name: Marshal McBride
7-complete.text:
Well done, citizen.  Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us.  And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.

For defeating them, you have my gratitude.
7-complete.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup

71-accept.name: Unknown
71-accept.text: Now that you have both medallions, deliver them to Guard Thomas at the bridge so that he might know the fate of his murdered guards.
71-accept.title: Report to Thomas

71-complete.name: Guard Thomas
71-complete.text: You have confirmed my fears, $N.  The murlocs are a threat we cannot ignore.
71-complete.title: Report to Thomas

71-progress.name: Guard Thomas
71-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
71-progress.title: Report to Thomas

76-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
76-complete.text:
Kobolds at the Jasperlode Mine, you say?  Curses!  The situation is worsening by the minute!

Thank you for the report, $N.  But I wish that the news you brought was good news.
76-complete.title: The Jasperlode Mine

76-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
76-progress.text: Hail, $N.  What do you have to report? Have you scouted the Jasperlode Mine?
76-progress.title: The Jasperlode Mine

83-accept.name: Sara Timberlain
83-accept.text:
The Defias gang in Northshire wears burlap masks, but the Defias in Elwynn wear linen which I can use to make fine linen goods.

Bring me red linen bandanas and I'll use them to fashion something for you.

Defias gang members have camps pocketed throughout Elwynn.
83-accept.title: Red Linen Goods

83-complete.name: Sara Timberlain
83-complete.text:
Ah, these are nice bandanas, if a little rough...

Here you are!
83-complete.title: Red Linen Goods

83-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
83-progress.text: I'm running low on linen, $N.  Do you have any for me?
83-progress.title: Red Linen Goods

84-progress.name: Billy Maclure
84-progress.text: Ugh... I'm starving!  Do you have that pie for me, $N?
84-progress.title: Back to Billy

86-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
86-progress.text:
I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!

Do you have that boar meat?
86-progress.title: Pie for Billy

86667-accept.name: Grenhild Darktalon
86667-accept.text:
My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
86667-accept.title: Snowbound

86667-complete.name: Norric Lochthane
86667-complete.text:
This jar is for me?

Snow! Grenhild did it! She sent the snow that I asked for!

A pity, though, I was hoping she would come and visit in person.

Well, regardless, thank you for your effort. This is a real help for my work.
86667-complete.title: Snowbound

87-complete.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-complete.text:
Oh, you found it!  Thank you, thank you dear!

Here, take this.  It was my husband's and he always said it was lucky.  If only he didn't forget it on his last campaign! *sniff*
87-complete.title: Goldtooth

87-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found my necklace?
87-progress.title: Goldtooth

88-complete.name: Ma Stonefield
88-complete.text:
Thank goodness!  That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop!  Thank you, $N.

Now, do either of these suit you?
88-complete.title: Princess Must Die!

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

9-accept.name: Farmer Saldean
9-accept.text:
Look at what has happened to this place!  These lands were once occupied by good farm folk.  But the damned thieves have driven them all off.  Not me, though!  But it seems some Harvest Watchers have taken over the fields.

If you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them.  Come back when you're done for your pay.  If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
9-accept.title: The Killing Fields

91723-accept.name: Hamish Bergwort
91723-accept.text:
Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?
91723-accept.title: Delicate Instruments

91724-complete.name: Hamish Bergwort
91724-complete.text: It seems like everything is working properly. Thank you, $N.
91724-complete.title: Delicate Instruments

91725-complete.name: Blixie Fitzwink
91725-complete.text: Oh, that's a relief! It looks like it's all here. Thank you!
91725-complete.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies

91732-accept.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-accept.text: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?
91732-accept.title: Good Steel

91732-complete.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-complete.text: Oh, very nice. Do you see that shine? Truly, they don't make them like they used to.
91732-complete.title: Good Steel

91732-progress.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-progress.text: Have you been to the mine yet?
91732-progress.title: Good Steel

91733-complete.name: Ormin Pelford
91733-complete.text: You look a bit damp, $N. Sorry about that. But thank you for retrieving the supplies.
91733-complete.title: Downstream

91741-accept.name: Unknown
91741-accept.text:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
91741-accept.title: Nibbled-On Book

91741-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91741-complete.text:
Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!

Thanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?
91741-complete.title: Nibbled-On Book

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-accept.name: Brother Paxton
91743-accept.text: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743-accept.title: Rascally Rodents

91743-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91743-complete.text:
Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.

But there's still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
91743-complete.title: Rascally Rodents

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

91745-accept.name: Brother Paxton
91745-accept.text: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
91745-accept.title: Mining Consultant

91745-complete.name: Kelsey Fargo
91745-complete.text: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.
91745-complete.title: Mining Consultant

91752-accept.name: Kelsey Fargo
91752-accept.text:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
91752-accept.title: The Big Picture

91752-complete.name: Marshal McBride
91752-complete.text:
Thank you for returning these stolen books, $N. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once.

You're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!
91752-complete.title: The Big Picture

91752-progress.name: Marshal McBride
91752-progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752-progress.title: The Big Picture

91758-accept.name: Marshal McBride
91758-accept.text:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
91758-accept.title: Follow That Kobold!

91758-complete.name: Tordrin Sternblade
91758-complete.text: I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.
91758-complete.title: Follow That Kobold!

91772-accept.name: Tordrin Sternblade
91772-accept.text:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.
91772-accept.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91772-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-complete.text:
What's this, $N? Tracking kobolds?

Well, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds.

Good work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.
91772-complete.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91772-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772-progress.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91775-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
91775-accept.text:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
91775-accept.title: Book Return

91775-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91775-progress.text: Have you found all the books yet?
91775-progress.title: Book Return

91777-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91777-complete.text: Oh, $N! Thank you so much for saving my library. You've done me an amazing service. Please take one of these fine weapons. They were intended for the militia, but you can make better use of them.
91777-complete.title: Rare Books

91777-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91777-progress.text: Have you found all my missing books yet?
91777-progress.title: Rare Books

92124-accept.name: Brother Paxton
92124-accept.text:
We need to take stock of how many books are missing!

Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.

He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.

Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!
92124-accept.title: Book Inventory

92124-complete.name: Daniel
92124-complete.text:
Yah, I overheard. I warned Brother Paxton three times about the kobolds tunneling under the abbey.

It looks like the kobolds have taken a lot of books. There are whole bookshelves emptied out. You should probably see what Brother Paxton wants you to do about it.

While you're here, can I talk to you about tradeskills? I'd be happy to answer any questions you have, or point you toward the local trainers.
92124-complete.title: Book Inventory

92742-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92742-accept.text:
We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.

Go to the Jansen Stead in the north and the Molsen Farm northwest of here, and collect samples from the wells there.
92742-accept.title: Testing the Wells

92744-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-accept.text:
The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.
Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
92744-accept.title: Murloc Gills

95041-accept.name: Jemma Quikswitch
95041-accept.text:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.

The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...
95041-accept.title: Data Hoarders

95212-accept.name: Rudra Amberstill
95212-accept.text:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
95212-accept.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95212-complete.name: Rudra Amberstill
95212-complete.text: These pelts will make excellent saddles. You've done the Alliance proud, $c!
95212-complete.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95212-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
95212-progress.text: You look chilly, $c. How goes the hunt?
95212-progress.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95213-accept.name: Unknown
95213-accept.text:
The keg is stamped:

BLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER

You get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.
95213-accept.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95213-complete.name: Quarrymaster Thesten
95213-complete.text:
<The dwarf turns pale as he sees the empty keg.>

...Where did you find this?
95213-complete.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95214-accept.name: Quarrymaster Thesten
95214-accept.text: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it.
95214-accept.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95214-progress.name: Quarrymaster Thesten
95214-progress.text: I hope you've got good news for me?
95214-progress.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95998-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-accept.text:
Well howdy there, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

95998-complete.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
95998-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96390-accept.name: Earthseer Farsen
96390-accept.text:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' not sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
96390-accept.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud

96390-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96390-complete.text:
These Dark Irons may be our cousins but they ain't family, that's for sure. I shed no tears for any misfortune that befalls them that stray too far from that accursed mountain o' theirs.

Hopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.
96390-complete.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud

96391-accept.name: Unknown
96391-accept.text:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.>
96391-accept.title: Underground Map

96391-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96391-complete.text:
Judging by this map, it certainly looks like these Dark Irons are planning some sort of incursion into the vaults beneath Ironforge. The band ye busted up to the east must be a scouting force.

Thank ye for bringing me this. If we hurry, we might be able to beat them to whatever their goal is down there.
96391-complete.title: Underground Map

96392-accept.name: Earthseer Farsen
96392-accept.text:
Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.

If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
96392-accept.title: Farsen's Watch

96392-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96392-complete.text:
So ye see now, $c? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.

Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. Hows about a bit o' violence?
96392-complete.title: Farsen's Watch

96393-accept.name: Earthseer Farsen
96393-accept.text:
Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults. 

My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard. 

Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
96393-accept.title: Old Ironforge Incursion

96626-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96626-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96626-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96626-complete.name: Tomas
96626-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.
